## Outcome

Describe the learner or reviewer problem, the smallest implemented change, and the evidence that it worked.

Closes #

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run docs:check`
- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] New calculation, import, assessment, persistence, or release boundaries have deterministic regression coverage
- [ ] Keyboard, focus, contrast, reduced motion, resized-window behavior, and both appearance modes were checked when relevant
- [ ] Examples and screenshots are synthetic or fully redacted
- [ ] No credentials, account data, personal journals, secure assessment material, generated builds, or unlicensed market data were added

## Product and evidence boundary

- [ ] No live signals, brokerage authentication, account scraping, screen watching, order execution, hidden AI calls, or outcome promises
- [ ] Provider identity, timestamps, limitations, provenance, ambiguity, and missing evidence remain visible
- [ ] The change does not reward trade count, position size, screen time, streak preservation, or profit
- [ ] README, documentation hub, architecture, screenshots, changelog, and release notes match the actual scope of the change

## Visual evidence

Include before/after images only when they materially help review. Follow [`docs/images/README.md`](../docs/images/README.md) and explain the synthetic state shown.
